Workshops

Want to learn a new skill? Try one of our beginner workshops.

Beginner & Project Workshops

Not looking for a membership? We run a range of workshops to help you learn new skills and gain more confidence in using tools like 3D printers and laser cutters. We run both beginner introductions, and project specific workshops that cover many topics like:

  • Laser cutting
  • 3D printing
  • Laser cut LED lamps

Community projects

Some of the projects our community have worked on.

What is a makerspace?

A makerspace or hackerspace generally refer to the same thing. According to hackerspaces.org, they are “community-operated physical places, where people share their interest in tinkering with technology, meet and work on their projects, and learn from each other.”

We think the phrase “makerspace” is more inclusive and friendly than “hackerspace” as the latter often has a negative connotation. There are several makerspaces or hackerspaces in Brisbane. We hope to differentiate ourselves by fostering a friendly and engaging community that is fun to be a part of.

Whether you want to call it a hackerspace or makerspace, we think everyone will have a great time and make new connections. We encourage you to come along to one of our social events or community open nights to learn more and see what all the fuss is about!
